proposals.hypothesis: A single immutable estate graph will expose higher-leverage drift than repository-by-repository narrative review.
proposals.objective: Bind every observed product and provider artifact to canonical GitHub source and a current evidence state.
stop_conditions: Default head drifts before proposal finalization
success_metrics: 100% of proposed targets have an exact base state
tests: Every edge names immutable source evidence
Unknown or partial observations remain non-green
proposals.title: Canonical estate graph and exact-head gap queue

proposals.hypothesis: Held-out, contamination-aware evaluation plus immutable training receipts will eliminate the largest model-readiness ambiguity.
proposals.objective: Turn model, adapter, dataset, and evaluation artifacts into a reproducible promotion ladder without conflating publication with qualification.
stop_conditions: Model identity or exact revision is unavailable
success_metrics: 100% critical safety and stale-state cases blocked
All published claims link to retained evidence
tests: Provider bytes match immutable source manifest
proposals.title: Governed model and dataset qualification ladder

proposals.hypothesis: A generated, signed public projection will prevent static estate counts and runtime claims from drifting apart.
proposals.objective: Make the application and diligence domain report the same current, source-bound estate state.
stop_conditions: Provider publication parity is not verified
success_metrics: Every public green state has a current evidence link
tests: Static counts match authenticated inventory scope labels
proposals.title: Dual-domain live evidence projection
